title: A Delete Part that fails with a server error shows Failed to delete part. and keeps the part
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: two scratch parts created in step 1 (unused). Chrome DevTools Network tab open (request blocking / forced 500 for the delete request).
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Inventory > New Inventory Part twice: QAPL-DEL9A and QAPL-DEL9B (Description, Part Number, Category, a default bin).
  2. Open QAPL-DEL9A > Delete Part; in Network note the delete request.
  3. In DevTools, block that delete request's URL pattern (any part id) so it fails with a server error (500).
  4. Open QAPL-DEL9B > Delete Part.
  5. Close the dialog and search Inventory for "QAPL-DEL9B".
  6. Remove the block; open QAPL-DEL9B > Delete Part.
custom_expected:
1. Both parts are created.
  2. QAPL-DEL9A is deleted at once with no confirmation; the dialog closes and the list reloads.
  3. The block is active.
  4. Error toast "Failed to delete part." with "Please try again." under it, fading after 3 seconds; the dialog stays open.
  5. QAPL-DEL9B is still listed.
  6. QAPL-DEL9B is deleted at once.
